purpose: Minimal paired 2x2 mechanism screen for the current variable-token MambaACF forecast path.
research_question: Do the direct signed ACF anchor and the existing soft static ACF memory have additive or interacting value under the same forecast trunk?
estimand: For each dataset and seed, estimate anchor and memory simple effects and the difference-in-differences interaction: (anchor+memory - memory) - (anchor - plain).
evidence_boundary: Exploratory validation-only evidence on ETTh1 and traffic at H96 with three paired seeds. It cannot establish a test-set gain, generalization, SOTA, speed, or publication readiness.
claim_boundary: The matrix can reject the interaction candidate or justify a separately frozen test replication. A favorable mean is descriptive and must not be used to stack further mechanisms.

required_before_launch: review the four-arm factorial estimand and nested plain reference
confirm that raw ACF sidecars are fit from the training split only and identical within every coordinate
confirm that validation val_loss is the only selection metric and test evaluation remains disabled
freeze plan/source/environment hashes and use a fresh output root

phases.name: plain_h96
phases.purpose: Reference arm: no direct anchor and no soft static ACF memory.

phases.name: anchor_only_h96
phases.purpose: Anchor-only arm: direct signed train-only ACF anchor without soft memory.

phases.name: memory_only_h96
phases.purpose: Soft-memory-only arm: static train-only availability-weighted ACF memory without direct anchor.

phases.name: anchor_memory_h96
phases.purpose: Combined arm: direct signed ACF anchor plus the existing soft static ACF memory.

MambaACFVariable.provenance_rule: Persist the registered alias, executable model, and resolved overrides in every manifest/config record.

comparison_contract.metric_source_description: Best validation scaled MSE is the minimum finite val_loss; no test metrics are produced.
comparison_contract.pairing_unit: same dataset, horizon, and seed across all four arms
planned_contrasts: anchor simple effect at memory off: anchor_only - plain
anchor simple effect at memory on: anchor_memory - memory_only
memory simple effect at anchor off: memory_only - plain
memory simple effect at anchor on: anchor_memory - anchor_only
comparison_contract.interaction_sign: negative favors sub-additive error reduction; positive favors super-additive error reduction; zero indicates no detectable interaction
comparison_contract.selection_rule: Use no test metric and do not select a factor combination from any future test run. A descriptive follow-up gate requires the interaction CI to be interpreted jointly with dataset-specific simple effects, not pooled alone.
comparison_contract.one_factor_rule: All four phases share model alias/executable, variable-token trunk, raw train-only sidecar construction, lag bank, optimizer, scheduler, split, batch, and epoch budget. Only mamba_acf_anchor_copy and mamba_use_acf_memory vary.
